name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.KSplit.table_sum_lower
title: AM-GM floor for split-witness tables
statement: If k nonnegative table sizes N_i have product at least t^k (the tables jointly index at least t^k witness tuples), then their sum is at least k t. With t = 2^(m/k) this is the k 2^(m/k) floor for any scheme whose decryption reads one entry from each of k explicitly generated tables.
